title: Common operational ports with security context
summary: Use common defaults as investigation hints, never as proof that a service is trusted or safely exposed.

concepts.title: Common defaults
concepts.explanation: SSH 22, DNS 53, HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, Jenkins commonly 8080, Kubernetes API commonly 6443 and PostgreSQL commonly 5432.

concepts.title: Exposure context
concepts.explanation: Services can use non-default ports, proxies, Unix sockets or private network bindings.

concepts.title: Security boundary
concepts.explanation: Opening a port broadens reachability and should follow an explicit need, least-privilege scope and verification.

limitations: A listening port does not prove the service identity, authentication, encryption or health.
Default-port lists must not be used to justify broad firewall changes.
